title: Baking soda water
summary: ¼ tsp sodium bicarbonate in water twice daily (≥2 h from meals)—an alkaline buffer habit distinct from sparkling CO₂ water.

sections.heading: What it is
sections.body: Baking soda water is plain sodium bicarbonate dissolved in a glass of water—not baking powder, not sparkling soda water. A common lifestyle dose is ¼ teaspoon in a full glass, twice daily, each dose at least two hours away from meals so it does not fight stomach acid needed for digestion. This is the alkaline bicarbonate route; carbonated water is the fizzy CO₂ route.

sections.heading: Why people use it
sections.body: Sodium bicarbonate buffers acid. Clinicians sometimes use bicarbonate under supervision for kidney disease and acid–base balance. Early research has also linked oral bicarbonate to a less inflammatory immune profile in some settings—enough for the habit to appear in mitochondrial lifestyle stacks, not enough to call it a cure. Treat it as a simple hydration adjunct, not a therapy claim.

sections.heading: Baking soda vs sparkling water
sections.body: Baking soda in water makes a mildly alkaline sodium bicarbonate solution—no bubbles unless you add acid. Carbonated water dissolves CO₂ and is acidic and fizzy. Both touch CO₂–bicarbonate chemistry in the body, but they arrive differently. Practice sparkling choices under Drinking water; practice baking soda under Vagus nerve stimulation.

sections.heading: Safe basics
sections.body: Use plain sodium bicarbonate only. Extra sodium matters if you have high blood pressure, heart failure, or kidney limits—ask your clinician first. Do not stack large doses of antacids. Stop if you feel unwell. This does not replace meals, sleep, morning light, or prescribed care.

sections.heading: What is solid vs framework
sections.body: Solid ground: bicarbonate buffers acid; oral bicarbonate is a real clinical tool in selected medical contexts; sodium load is a real safety issue. Framework / teaching layer: that twice-daily baking soda water reliably “resets” mitochondrial or vagal tone the way some lifestyle write-ups imply. Keep the habit humble and clinician-aware.

sections.heading: How to use it here
sections.body: Practice Vagus nerve stimulation → Baking soda water for each ¼-tsp dose (twice daily when you follow the full protocol). Pair with Drinking water, Daylight-aligned hydration, and deuterium-aware meals in the Water pillar. Educational only—not medical advice for kidney disease, autoimmunity, or blood pressure.
